verdict.rationale: Community Phone's own docs say users can "set up automated calls to check on them or remind them as needed" for a loved one's line. That is a user-configured automation that runs unattended, and call routing/roll-over rules also execute automatically once set. This is a single thin mention, with no detail on scheduling, triggers, or agent-style automation, and automatic spam blocking is a built-in feature rather than a user-built automation. Missing for 10: documented automation builder or scheduling details, trigger/condition configuration, API or programmatic automation (OpenAPI probes returned 404), AI-driven or agentic workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
